ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.8). UI selection actions: the per-row R button is gone and the recommendation is now a top-bar R button that acts only on the selected Work Control row (disabled when nothing is selected). A new top-bar Details button opens a read-only window for the selected pawn with its name/title, top skills with levels/passions, and the WorkType order with rank, best skill/passion and status (active/off/incapable). The window has a close X and a Close button and is the foundation for a future advanced tab. Everything else is unchanged: flat single-line cards, flexible filtering pawn search, row selection and double-click select/camera, shared horizontal scroll, outer vertical scroll, Draw/Manual/Both modes, Open Work tab, and the vanilla Work-tab manual priority above 4 with dynamic max and capture guards. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
